confidence_notes: The FX figure is the RBA's 18 Nov 2026 observation of 0.6720 USD per AUD, found through web search. The food and drink anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living sites, which disagree widely and sometimes use older data. Inexpensive meal (about $6–7), cappuccino (about $4.5) and mid-range dinner for two (about $35) are the better-supported figures. Beer is the least reliable item because sources range from about $4 to $13 or more. I set it at the hotel-bar level, which is the usual place to drink in Oman, and it matches a March 2026 Qurum hotel-bar guide of OMR 3–4.5 for draught beer. That guide also gave wine at OMR 3–7 and cocktails at OMR 4–8, and I used midpoints with taxes and service charges in mind. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge only. I did not search for accommodation prices or inspect any listings. Hostels are scarce in Muscat, so those two figures are especially uncertain. I picked these prices for July, which is low season with extreme heat.
comparable_city_reasoning: I compared Muscat with other Gulf cities, being cheaper than Dubai and Doha for hotels and meals but similar on heavily taxed, hotel-only alcohol. Restaurant prices follow local Omani and South Asian eateries, which are cheap.
